concepts.learning_objective: Explain why rules are needed when many people live together in a society.
Distinguish between governance as a process and government as the system that makes and enforces rules and laws.
Identify the roles of the legislature, the executive and the judiciary.
Explain how separation of powers provides checks and balances among the three organs.
Describe the local, State and Central levels of government and when each acts.
Match the organs, heads and main functions of the Central and State governments.
State the meaning and origin of the word democracy.
Distinguish between representative democracy and direct democracy with examples.
Explain grassroots democracy as the participation of ordinary citizens in decisions that affect them.
